WITH catalogue_references AS 
(SELECT snapshot_statistics.item_id AS item_id, snapshot_statistics.variant_key AS variant_key, CASE WHEN (sum(CASE WHEN (snapshot_statistics.algorithm != $1::VARCHAR) THEN $2::INTEGER ELSE $3::INTEGER END) > $4::INTEGER) THEN NULL ELSE round(avg(snapshot_statistics.recent_price) FILTER (WHERE observations.retrieved_at >= $5::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)) END AS market_value, CASE WHEN (sum(CASE WHEN (snapshot_statistics.algorithm != $1::VARCHAR) THEN $2::INTEGER ELSE $3::INTEGER END) > $6::INTEGER) THEN NULL ELSE round(avg(snapshot_statistics.recent_price)) END AS historical_value, count(snapshot_statistics.recent_price) FILTER (WHERE observations.retrieved_at >= $7::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS coverage_days, max(CAST(observations.synthetic AS INTEGER)) AS synthetic 
FROM snapshot_statistics JOIN observations ON observations.snapshot_id = snapshot_statistics.snapshot_id JOIN daily_observations ON daily_observations.observation_id = observations.id 
WHERE daily_observations.market
